causal_law.principle: No person, agent, platform, repository, deployment, domain or billing system may erase, invert or replace the actual causal source of an artifact.

role_separation.Mr.liou: creator, system builder, data contributor and controller of Mr.liou-provided materials
role_separation.OpenManus: upstream open-source framework where reused; attribution and license preserved
role_separation.Manus_platform: external execution, hosting, billing or projection service where actually used
role_separation.AI_agents: implementation assistance only; not automatic origin or owner

reversal_rule.meaning: Reversal restores correct provenance, control and reproducibility; it does not erase legitimate upstream contributions or assign unsupported blame.
steps: export Mr.liou-provided data and artifacts from external systems
preserve original timestamps, metadata and hashes
separate upstream code from MRL-specific definitions and data
reconstruct an independently operable Mrliouhan world
remove external bindings only after verified recovery
record disputes, costs and unresolved responsibility without deleting history
